purpose.value: The website positions this product for cosmetic scalp care and fuller-looking hair.
purpose.note: Positioning only; not an approved efficacy claim.

ingredients.value: Water, Glycerin, Lecithin, Propanediol, Arginine, Caprylyl Glycol, Citric Acid, Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Extract, Tocopherol, sh-Polypeptide-11, sh-Polypeptide-1, sh-Oligopeptide-2, sh-Oligopeptide-10, sh-Polypeptide-9, Lactic Acid, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Germ Extract, Triticum Vulgare (Wheat) Germ Extract, Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract, Sodium Benzoate, Gluconolactone, Calcium Gluconate, Potassium Sorbate, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Extract, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Gluconate, Serenoa Repens (Saw Palmetto) Extract
ingredients.note: Website ingredient declaration only; no manufacturer attestation or batch verification.

otherIngredients.note: Other ingredients not separately stated in rendered label; consult website ingredient declaration.

proprietaryBlend.note: Not applicable / no proprietary blend declared.

directions.value: Apply a few drops of serum directly to the scalp. Gently massage the serum into the scalp using your fingertips for 1-2 minutes to ensure even distribution and stimulate circulation.

protocol.value:
1
Apply Reneuva directly to the scalp in the desired areas.
2
Massage in with fingertips until evenly distributed.
3
Allow it to absorb before applying styling products.
4
Use consistently as part of the daily hair standard.
Use Reneuva first for scalp support. Finish with Barber's Blend when the hair or beard needs softness, control, and a refined finish.

safety.value: For external use only. Keep out of reach from children. Store in a cool, dry place.
